xs.$description: 4px 10px — 24px control. The smallest text control, riding inside a composite rather than in a bar of its own — the Tolbi AI composer's « Arrêter » (ADR-0059). Label-md-strong's 16px line box; 26px rendered with its border (ADR-0033)

md.$description: 10px 14px — 40px control. Button, InputField, Dropdown and InputDropdown all landed here independently

lg-compact.$description: 6px 16px — 36px control. lg's type and horizontal rhythm compressed to a 36px height (6x2 + the 24px label-xl line box). Distinct from sm, which is also 36px but carries 14px type
